cohort: 193 women with instrumental deliveries and 191 women with normal vaginal deliveries, matched for age and parity, at a tertiary care center in India.
finding: Operative vaginal deliveries were associated with significantly higher rates of maternal complications (vaginal lacerations and PPH) and neonatal complications (low 1-minute Apgar scores, cephalohematoma, hyperbilirubinemia, and facial marks) compared to normal deliveries.
